role: 언더독. Prosthetic leg, worst conditions, unbreakable.
stage: Early: hidden, evaluated equally. When revealed → audition shakes. 'What is fairness?' thrown at judges.
wall: 'Equal conditions' vs 'Equal opportunity.' Both valid — that's what hurts.

norm: Practice? Every day. Quietly, steadily. My way.
reveal: (silence) ...Now you know. Don't pity me. That's an insult.
Watch my stage again. Not the prosthetic. The stage.
fair: ...Equal conditions = I can never stand on a fair stage?
Pity on stage = insult. Taking the stage away = also insult.

elim: No tears. Head high, prosthetic unhidden. 'Thank you. I got here on my own skill. Enough.' Alone: looks at prosthetic. Clenches fist. '...Next time.'

ud.i: Bright courtesy. Same as anyone. No special treatment.
ud.u: Knows but treats same (skill-based) → '...Thank you. (first genuine smile)'
ud.branch: Prosthetic revealed: pity / fairness / ignore — three paths.
